sections.text_helper: Section 16.6.11 "EXTI falling edge pending register 2 (EXTI_FPR2)" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 460.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x030
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Contains only register bits for configurable events.
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 7 FPIF39: configurable event inputs x falling edge pending bit
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV39 is disabled, FPIF39 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV39 is enabled, FPIF39 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this FPIF39 is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: No falling edge trigger request occurred
1: Falling edge trigger request occurred
This bit is set when the falling edge event arrives on the configurable event line. This bit is
cleared by writing 1 to it.
Bits 6:5 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 4 FPIF36: configurable event inputs x falling edge pending bit
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV36 is disabled, FPIF36 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.FPIF36 is enabled, FPIF36 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this FPIF36 is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: No falling edge trigger request occurred
1: Falling edge trigger request occurred
This bit is set when the falling edge event arrives on the configurable event line. This bit is
cleared by writing 1 to it.
Bit 3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 2 FPIF34: configurable event inputs x falling edge pending bit
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV34 is disabled, FPIF34 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV34 is enabled, FPIF34 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this FPIF34 is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: No falling edge trigger request occurred
1: Falling edge trigger request occurred
This bit is set when the falling edge event arrives on the configurable event line. This bit is
cleared by writing 1 to it.
Bits 1:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
